' NEONWAR - a twin stick neon arena shooter for the ZX Spectrum Next, in NTC BASIC (VB5 flavour)
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' Vector graphics as the CITY3D demo draws them, on the Next's Layer 2 (L2.cls: 256 x 192, 256
' colours, two buffers, clipped lines). The floor grid, the frame and the text are the tilemap
' (Tiles.cls) under Layer 2, which is see-through where nothing is drawn. Spawn markers are
' hardware sprites, the sound the AY.
'
' Keys: S up, X down, Z left, C right, the cursor keys (5 6 7 8) fire that way (two at once: diagonals),
'       Space a smart bomb. A Kempston joystick moves; its fire button shoots the way you go.
' Enemies: pinwheels wander, diamonds hunt you, squares hunt and split in two when shot.
' Every 25 kills the multiplier goes up (to x10); losing a life sets it back to x1.
Option Explicit
Option Turbo

Const NE = 40, NB = 20, NP = 48, NS = 8
Const SP_SHIP = 8                       ' the ship's sprite (0-7: the spawn markers)
Const AW = 256, AH = 192                ' the arena: Layer 2's screen
' enemy kinds
Const K_WANDER = 1, K_DIAMOND = 2, K_SQUARE = 3, K_MINI = 4
' colours (Layer 2: RRRGGGBB)
Const C_SHIP = &HFF, C_SHOT = &HFC, C_WANDER = &HA7, C_DIAMOND = &H1F, C_SQUARE = &H1C, C_MINI = &H9D
Const C_BG = &HE3                        ' transparent: the tilemap's grid shows through

' shapes: one table of points (L2.Shape's form), so* the offsets
Dim shp(1499) As Byte
Dim shpn As Integer
Dim longText As String Max 120          ' (the longest string: the shape texts passed to MakeShape fit)
Dim soShip(7) As Integer, soWander(7) As Integer, soDiamond(1) As Integer, soSquare(3) As Integer, soMini(3) As Integer
Dim sn(15) As Integer
Dim dx8(7) As Integer, dy8(7) As Integer, wayt(8) As Integer
' enemies
Dim ek(39) As Integer, ex(39) As Integer, ey(39) As Integer, evx(39) As Integer, evy(39) As Integer
Dim ea(39) As Integer, et(39) As Integer, epx(39) As Integer, epy(39) As Integer, er(39) As Integer
Dim nen As Integer
' shots
Dim bon(19) As Integer, bx(19) As Integer, by(19) As Integer, bvx(19) As Integer, bvy(19) As Integer
' particles
Dim pl(47) As Integer, px(47) As Integer, py(47) As Integer, pvx(47) As Integer, pvy(47) As Integer, pc(47) As Integer
Dim pnext As Integer
' spawns on the way
Dim sk(7) As Integer, sxx(7) As Integer, syy(7) As Integer, st(7) As Integer
' the ship
Dim sx As Integer, sy As Integer, sdir As Integer, alive As Integer, inv As Integer, cool As Integer, dead As Integer
Dim score As Long, hiscore As Long, nextlife As Long
Dim lives As Integer, bombs As Integer, kills As Integer, mult As Integer, level As Integer, over As Integer
Dim frames As Integer, ltimer As Integer, wtimer As Integer, seed As Integer, firewas As Integer, bombwas As Integer
Dim hudDirty As Integer, sps As Integer
Dim i As Integer, j As Integer

Setup
Nx.Border 0
Tiles.Init
Spr.Init
GfxData.Load
Sfx.Init
L2.Init C_BG
Nx.Layers Nx.OrderSLU
hiscore = 50000
Do
  Title
  Play
  GameOver
Loop

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- tables, shapes
Sub Setup()
  Dim k As Integer
  ' sin x 64, 16 steps round
  sn(0) = 0 : sn(1) = 24 : sn(2) = 45 : sn(3) = 59 : sn(4) = 64 : sn(5) = 59 : sn(6) = 45 : sn(7) = 24
  For k = 8 To 15
    sn(k) = -sn(k - 8)
  Next
  ' 8 ways: 0 right, then clockwise (y goes down the screen)
  For k = 0 To 7
    dx8(k) = Cs(k * 2) : dy8(k) = sn(k * 2)
  Next
  wayt(0) = 5 : wayt(1) = 6 : wayt(2) = 7 : wayt(3) = 4 : wayt(4) = -1 : wayt(5) = 0 : wayt(6) = 3 : wayt(7) = 2 : wayt(8) = 1
  shpn = 0
  For k = 0 To 7
    soShip(k) = MakeShape("8 0 -6 -6 -2 0 -6 6 8 0 P -2 0 -4 0", k * 2, 64)
    soWander(k) = MakeShape("0 0 7 -3 7 3 0 0 -7 3 -7 -3 0 0 P 0 -6 0 6", k * 2, 64)
  Next
  soDiamond(0) = MakeShape("0 -7 5 0 0 7 -5 0 0 -7", 0, 64)
  soDiamond(1) = MakeShape("0 -6 4 0 0 6 -4 0 0 -6 P 0 -3 2 0 0 3 -2 0 0 -3", 0, 64)
  For k = 0 To 3
    soSquare(k) = MakeShape("-6 -6 6 -6 6 6 -6 6 -6 -6 P -6 -6 6 6 P 6 -6 -6 6", k, 64)
    soMini(k) = MakeShape("-3 -3 3 -3 3 3 -3 3 -3 -3", k, 64)
  Next
End Sub

Function Cs(ByVal a As Integer) As Integer
  Cs = sn((a + 4) And 15)
End Function

' a shape from "x y x y ... P x y ...", turned by ang (16ths of a turn) and scaled (64 = 1):
' its offset in shp
Function MakeShape(ByVal s As String, ByVal ang As Integer, ByVal sc As Integer) As Integer
  Dim p As Integer, q As Integer, tok As String, n As Integer, start As Integer
  Dim x As Integer, y As Integer, rx As Integer, ry As Integer, havex As Integer, c As Integer, sg As Integer
  start = shpn
  shpn = shpn + 1
  n = 0 : havex = 0
  c = Cs(ang) : sg = sn(ang And 15)
  s = s & " "
  p = 1
  Do While p <= Len(s)
    q = InStr(p, s, " ")
    If q = 0 Then Exit Do
    tok = Mid$(s, p, q - p)
    p = q + 1
    If tok = "P" Then
      shp(shpn) = 128 : shp(shpn + 1) = 0 : shpn = shpn + 2 : n = n + 1
    ElseIf tok <> "" Then
      If havex = 0 Then
        x = Val(tok) : havex = 1
      Else
        y = Val(tok) : havex = 0
        rx = ((x * c - y * sg) \ 8) * sc \ 512
        ry = (x * sg + y * c) \ 8 * sc \ 512
        shp(shpn) = rx And 255 : shp(shpn + 1) = ry And 255
        shpn = shpn + 2 : n = n + 1
      End If
    End If
  Loop
  shp(start) = n
  MakeShape = start
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- input
Function FirePressed() As Integer
  Dim f As Integer
  f = Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyEnter) Or ((Keys.Joystick(0) And Keys.JoyFire1) <> 0)
  FirePressed = f And Not firewas
  firewas = f
End Function

' a way from -1 / 0 / 1 across and down: 0-7, or -1 for none
Function Way(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
  Way = wayt((y + 1) * 3 + x + 1)
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the screen round the arena
Sub Arena()
  Dim x As Integer, y As Integer, t As Integer
  Tiles.Fill 0
  For y = 4 To 27
    For x = 4 To 35
      If (y And 1) = 0 Then
        If (x And 1) = 0 Then t = GfxData.T_GRIDC Else t = GfxData.T_GRIDT
      Else
        If (x And 1) = 0 Then t = GfxData.T_GRIDL Else t = GfxData.T_GRIDN
      End If
      Tiles.Put x, y, t
    Next
  Next
  Tiles.Rect 4, 3, 32, 1, GfxData.T_FRAMET
  Tiles.Rect 4, 28, 32, 1, GfxData.T_FRAMEB
  Tiles.Rect 3, 4, 1, 24, GfxData.T_FRAMEL
  Tiles.Rect 36, 4, 1, 24, GfxData.T_FRAMER
  Tiles.Put 3, 3, GfxData.T_CORNER : Tiles.Put 36, 3, GfxData.T_CORNER + 1
  Tiles.Put 3, 28, GfxData.T_CORNER + 2 : Tiles.Put 36, 28, GfxData.T_CORNER + 3
End Sub

Sub Hud()
  Dim k As Integer
  Tiles.Text 4, 1, "SCORE " & Format$(score, "0000000")
  Tiles.Text 19, 1, "X" & CStr(mult) & " "
  Tiles.Rect 24, 1, 12, 1, 0
  For k = 1 To lives
    If k <= 6 Then Tiles.Put 23 + k, 1, GfxData.T_LIFE
  Next
  For k = 1 To bombs
    If k <= 5 Then Tiles.Put 36 - k, 1, GfxData.T_BOMB
  Next
  Tiles.Text 4, 30, "HI " & Format$(hiscore, "0000000")
  Tiles.Text 26, 30, "LEVEL " & Format$(level, "00")
  hudDirty = 0
End Sub

Sub BigText(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String, ByVal colour As Integer)
  Dim n As Integer, r As Integer, b As Integer, bits As Integer, ch As String
  For n = 1 To Len(s)
    ch = Mid$(s, n, 1)
    For r = 0 To 4
      bits = Glyph(ch, r)
      For b = 0 To 2
        If bits And (4 \ (2 ^ b)) Then Tiles.Put x + b, y + r, GfxData.T_LOGO + colour
      Next
    Next
    x = x + 4
  Next
End Sub

Function Glyph(ByVal ch As String, ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
  Dim p As String
  Select Case ch
    Case "N": p = "75555"
    Case "E": p = "74647"
    Case "O": p = "75557"
    Case "W": p = "55575"
    Case "A": p = "25755"
    Case "R": p = "75654"
    Case Else: p = "00000"
  End Select
  Glyph = Val(Mid$(p, r + 1, 1))
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the title
Sub Title()
  Dim k As Integer, a As Integer
  Spr.HideRange 0, 16
  Spr.Show
  L2.Wipe
  Frame : L2.Flip
  L2.Wipe
  Tiles.Fill 0
  BigText 8, 3, "NEON", 0
  BigText 25, 3, "WAR", 1
  Tiles.Text 8, 10, "S X Z C      MOVE U D L R"
  Tiles.Text 8, 12, "CURSOR KEYS  FIRE THAT WAY"
  Tiles.Text 8, 14, "SPACE        SMART BOMB"
  Tiles.Text 8, 16, "JOYSTICK     MOVE, FIRE"
  Tiles.Text 12, 20, "PINWHEEL     25"
  Tiles.Text 12, 22, "DIAMOND      50"
  Tiles.Text 12, 24, "SQUARE      100"
  Tiles.Text 4, 1, "SCORE " & Format$(score, "0000000")
  Tiles.Text 4, 30, "HI " & Format$(hiscore, "0000000")
  Tiles.Text 26, 30, "NTC BASIC"
  firewas = -1 : frames = 0
  Do
    L2.Clear
    a = frames And 7
    L2.Shape 42, 132, VarPtr(shp) + soWander(a), C_WANDER
    L2.Shape 42, 148, VarPtr(shp) + soDiamond((frames \ 8) And 1), C_DIAMOND
    L2.Shape 42, 164, VarPtr(shp) + soSquare((frames \ 4) And 3), C_SQUARE
    L2.Shape 220, 148, VarPtr(shp) + soShip((frames \ 8) And 7), C_SHIP
    Frame
    L2.Flip
    Sfx.Update
    frames = frames + 1 : seed = seed + 1
    If (frames And 31) = 0 Then Tiles.Text 10, 27, "PRESS SPACE TO START"
    If (frames And 31) = 20 Then Tiles.Text 10, 27, "                    "
  Loop Until FirePressed()
  Nx.Seed seed
  bombwas = -1
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- a game
Sub Play()
  Dim k As Integer
  score = 0 : lives = 3 : bombs = 3 : kills = 0 : mult = 1 : level = 1 : over = 0 : nextlife = 75000
  For k = 0 To NE - 1
    ek(k) = 0
  Next
  For k = 0 To NB - 1
    bon(k) = 0
  Next
  For k = 0 To NP - 1
    pl(k) = 0
  Next
  For k = 0 To NS - 1
    st(k) = 0
  Next
  nen = 0
  Arena
  L2.Wipe
  Frame : L2.Flip
  L2.Wipe
  Hud
  sx = 128 * 16 : sy = 96 * 16 : sdir = 6 : alive = 1 : inv = 100 : dead = 0
  ltimer = 0 : wtimer = 60 : frames = 0
  Do
    L2.Clear
    If alive Then
      MoveShip
    Else
      dead = dead - 1
      If dead = 0 Then Respawn
    End If
    MoveShots
    MoveEnemies
    Spawns
    Particles
    If alive Then DrawShip Else Spr.Hide SP_SHIP
    If hudDirty Then Hud
    Frame
    L2.Flip
    Spr.Show
    Sfx.Update
    frames = frames + 1
    ltimer = ltimer + 1
    If ltimer >= 900 Then
      ltimer = 0 : level = level + 1 : hudDirty = 1
    End If
  Loop Until over
End Sub

Sub MoveShip()
  Dim mx As Integer, my As Integer, fx As Integer, fy As Integer, w As Integer, j As Integer, b As Integer
  j = Keys.Joystick(0)
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyC) Or (j And Keys.JoyRight) Then mx = 1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyZ) Or (j And Keys.JoyLeft) Then mx = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyX) Or (j And Keys.JoyDown) Then my = 1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyS) Or (j And Keys.JoyUp) Then my = -1
  w = Way(mx, my)
  If w >= 0 Then
    sx = sx + dx8(w) \ 2
    sy = sy + dy8(w) \ 2
    If sx < 6 * 16 Then sx = 6 * 16
    If sx > (AW - 7) * 16 Then sx = (AW - 7) * 16
    If sy < 6 * 16 Then sy = 6 * 16
    If sy > (AH - 7) * 16 Then sy = (AH - 7) * 16
    sdir = w
  End If
  ' fire: the cursor keys, or the joystick's button the way it moves
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyRight) Then fx = 1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyLeft) Then fx = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyDown) Then fy = 1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyUp) Then fy = -1
  w = Way(fx, fy)
  If w < 0 And (j And Keys.JoyFire1) Then w = sdir
  If cool > 0 Then cool = cool - 1
  If w >= 0 And cool = 0 Then
    Shoot w
    If level > 3 Then
      Shoot (w + 1) And 7
      Shoot (w + 7) And 7
    End If
    cool = 5
    Sfx.Play 0, 40, 4, 9, 4, 0
  End If
  ' a smart bomb
  b = Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyM)
  If b And Not bombwas And bombs > 0 Then
    bombs = bombs - 1 : hudDirty = 1
    SmartBomb 1
  End If
  bombwas = b
  If inv > 0 Then inv = inv - 1
End Sub

Sub Shoot(ByVal w As Integer)
  Dim k As Integer
  For k = 0 To NB - 1
    If bon(k) = 0 Then
      bon(k) = 1
      bx(k) = sx : by(k) = sy
      bvx(k) = dx8(w) * 5 / 4 : bvy(k) = dy8(w) * 5 / 4
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Sub DrawShip()
  Dim c As Integer
  ' a hardware sprite (sprite 8), not Layer 2 lines: the hardware draws it every frame, whatever
  ' the drawing is doing; while it can't be hurt it flashes (palette 1: cyan)
  c = 0
  If inv > 0 And (frames And 4) Then c = Spr.Pal
  Spr.Put SP_SHIP, sx \ 16 + 32 - 8, sy \ 16 + 32 - 8, GfxData.S_SHIP + sdir, c
End Sub

Sub MoveShots()
  Dim k As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer, h As Integer
  For k = 0 To NB - 1
    If bon(k) Then
      bx(k) = bx(k) + bvx(k) : by(k) = by(k) + bvy(k)
      x = bx(k) \ 16 : y = by(k) \ 16
      If x < 1 Or x > AW - 2 Or y < 1 Or y > AH - 2 Then
        bon(k) = 0
      Else
        h = HitTest(x, y)
        If h >= 0 Then
          bon(k) = 0
          ShotEnemy h
        Else
          L2.Line x, y, (bx(k) - bvx(k)) \ 16, (by(k) - bvy(k)) \ 16, C_SHOT
        End If
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' the first enemy within its size of x, y, or -1 (Z80: it runs for every shot every frame)
Function HitTest(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld (ht_x), de
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld (ht_y), de
            ld de, 0                ; DE = the offset of enemy n (n * 2)
            ld b, {NE}
ht_lp:
            ld hl, {ek}
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, ht_nx
            ld hl, {er}
            add hl, de
            ld c, (hl)              ; its size
            ld hl, {epx}
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, (ht_x)
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, (ht_x + 1)
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a                 ; HL = x - epx
            bit 7, h
            jr z, ht_p1
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
ht_p1:
            ld a, h
            or a
            jr nz, ht_nx
            ld a, c
            cp l
            jr c, ht_nx
            ld hl, {epy}
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, (ht_y)
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, (ht_y + 1)
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            bit 7, h
            jr z, ht_p2
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
ht_p2:
            ld a, h
            or a
            jr nz, ht_nx
            ld a, c
            cp l
            jr c, ht_nx
            srl d                   ; a hit: n = offset / 2
            rr e
            jr ht_set
ht_nx:
            inc de
            inc de
            djnz ht_lp
            ld de, -1
ht_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            ret
ht_x:       dw 0
ht_y:       dw 0
#endasm
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- enemies
Sub AddEnemy(ByVal k As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Dim n As Integer
  For n = 0 To NE - 1
    If ek(n) = 0 Then
      ek(n) = k : ex(n) = x * 16 : ey(n) = y * 16 : evx(n) = 0 : evy(n) = 0 : ea(n) = Rnd(8) : et(n) = 0
      epx(n) = x : epy(n) = y
      Select Case k
        Case K_WANDER
          er(n) = 7
          evx(n) = Rnd(33) - 16 : evy(n) = Rnd(33) - 16
        Case K_DIAMOND: er(n) = 6
        Case K_SQUARE: er(n) = 7
        Case Else: er(n) = 4
      End Select
      nen = nen + 1
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Sub MoveEnemies()
  Dim n As Integer, k As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer, d As Integer, sp As Integer
  For n = 0 To NE - 1
    k = ek(n)
    If k Then
      Select Case k
        Case K_WANDER
          et(n) = et(n) + 1
          If et(n) >= 50 Then
            et(n) = 0 : evx(n) = Rnd(33) - 16 : evy(n) = Rnd(33) - 16
          End If
          If (frames And 1) Then ea(n) = (ea(n) + 1) And 7
        Case K_DIAMOND
          sp = 18 + level * 2
          If sp > 34 Then sp = 34
          If sx > ex(n) Then evx(n) = evx(n) + 2 Else evx(n) = evx(n) - 2
          If sy > ey(n) Then evy(n) = evy(n) + 2 Else evy(n) = evy(n) - 2
          If evx(n) > sp Then evx(n) = sp
          If evx(n) < -sp Then evx(n) = -sp
          If evy(n) > sp Then evy(n) = sp
          If evy(n) < -sp Then evy(n) = -sp
          ea(n) = (frames \ 8) And 1
        Case Else
          sp = 14
          If k = K_MINI Then sp = 24
          d = sx - ex(n)
          If d > 16 Then
            evx(n) = sp
          ElseIf d < -16 Then
            evx(n) = -sp
          Else
            evx(n) = 0
          End If
          d = sy - ey(n)
          If d > 16 Then
            evy(n) = sp
          ElseIf d < -16 Then
            evy(n) = -sp
          Else
            evy(n) = 0
          End If
          If (frames And 3) = 0 Then ea(n) = (ea(n) + 1) And 3
      End Select
      ex(n) = ex(n) + evx(n) : ey(n) = ey(n) + evy(n)
      If ex(n) < 6 * 16 Then
        ex(n) = 6 * 16 : evx(n) = -evx(n)
      End If
      If ex(n) > (AW - 7) * 16 Then
        ex(n) = (AW - 7) * 16 : evx(n) = -evx(n)
      End If
      If ey(n) < 6 * 16 Then
        ey(n) = 6 * 16 : evy(n) = -evy(n)
      End If
      If ey(n) > (AH - 7) * 16 Then
        ey(n) = (AH - 7) * 16 : evy(n) = -evy(n)
      End If
      x = ex(n) \ 16 : y = ey(n) \ 16
      epx(n) = x : epy(n) = y
      Select Case k
        Case K_WANDER: L2.Shape x, y, VarPtr(shp) + soWander(ea(n)), C_WANDER
        Case K_DIAMOND: L2.Shape x, y, VarPtr(shp) + soDiamond(ea(n)), C_DIAMOND
        Case K_SQUARE: L2.Shape x, y, VarPtr(shp) + soSquare(ea(n)), C_SQUARE
        Case Else: L2.Shape x, y, VarPtr(shp) + soMini(ea(n)), C_MINI
      End Select
      ' touching the ship
      If alive And inv = 0 Then
        If Abs(x - sx \ 16) < er(n) + 3 And Abs(y - sy \ 16) < er(n) + 3 Then ShipHit
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Sub ShotEnemy(ByVal n As Integer)
  Dim k As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer, pts As Integer, c As Integer
  k = ek(n) : x = epx(n) : y = epy(n)
  ek(n) = 0 : nen = nen - 1
  Select Case k
    Case K_WANDER: pts = 25 : c = C_WANDER
    Case K_DIAMOND: pts = 50 : c = C_DIAMOND
    Case K_SQUARE: pts = 100 : c = C_SQUARE
    Case Else: pts = 50 : c = C_MINI
  End Select
  Burst x, y, c, 10
  Sfx.Play 1, 10, 1, 13, 12, 1
  If k = K_SQUARE Then
    AddEnemy K_MINI, x - 6, y - 4
    AddEnemy K_MINI, x + 6, y + 4
  End If
  kills = kills + 1
  If kills Mod 25 = 0 And mult < 10 Then
    mult = mult + 1
    Sfx.Play 2, 120, -6, 13, 20, 0
  End If
  AddScore CLng(pts) * mult
End Sub

Sub AddScore(ByVal n As Long)
  score = score + n
  If score >= nextlife Then
    nextlife = nextlife + 75000
    If lives < 6 Then lives = lives + 1
    If bombs < 5 Then bombs = bombs + 1
  End If
  If score > hiscore Then hiscore = score
  hudDirty = 1
End Sub

' every enemy blown up (points only for a smart bomb: give 1)
Sub SmartBomb(ByVal pts As Integer)
  Dim n As Integer
  For n = 0 To NE - 1
    If ek(n) Then
      If pts Then AddScore 10
      Burst epx(n), epy(n), &HFF, 3
      ek(n) = 0
    End If
  Next
  nen = 0
  For n = 0 To NS - 1
    st(n) = 0
    Spr.Hide n
  Next
  Sfx.Play 1, 31, 0, 15, 50, 1
  Sfx.Play 2, 60, 6, 14, 40, 0
End Sub

Sub ShipHit()
  alive = 0 : dead = 100
  Burst sx \ 16, sy \ 16, C_SHIP, 24
  Burst sx \ 16, sy \ 16, C_SHOT, 16
  SmartBomb 0
  Sfx.Play 0, 200, 10, 15, 80, 0
  mult = 1 : kills = 0
End Sub

Sub Respawn()
  lives = lives - 1
  hudDirty = 1
  If lives = 0 Then
    over = 1
  Else
    alive = 1 : inv = 100 : sx = 128 * 16 : sy = 96 * 16
  End If
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- spawning
Sub Spawns()
  Dim n As Integer, c As Integer, k As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer, a As Integer, w As Integer
  ' the markers count down, then the enemy appears
  For n = 0 To NS - 1
    If st(n) > 0 Then
      st(n) = st(n) - 1
      If st(n) = 0 Then
        Spr.Hide n
        AddEnemy sk(n), sxx(n), syy(n)
      Else
        Spr.Put n, sxx(n) + 32 - 8, syy(n) + 32 - 8, GfxData.S_SPAWN + ((st(n) \ 4) And 1), 0
      End If
    End If
  Next
  If alive = 0 Then Exit Sub
  wtimer = wtimer - 1
  If wtimer > 0 Then Exit Sub
  w = 150 - level * 10
  If w < 50 Then w = 50
  wtimer = w
  If nen > 24 Then Exit Sub
  c = Rnd(5)
  If level < 2 And c > 2 Then c = Rnd(2)
  Select Case c
    Case 0          ' pinwheels anywhere
      For n = 1 To 3 + level \ 2
        Spot x, y
        Queue K_WANDER, x, y
      Next
    Case 1          ' diamonds in the corners
      Queue K_DIAMOND, 16, 16
      Queue K_DIAMOND, AW - 17, 16
      Queue K_DIAMOND, 16, AH - 17
      Queue K_DIAMOND, AW - 17, AH - 17
    Case 2          ' squares at one side
      a = Rnd(2) * (AW - 40) + 20
      For n = 0 To 2
        Queue K_SQUARE, a, 40 + n * 56
      Next
    Case 3          ' a ring of diamonds round the ship
      For n = 0 To 7
        x = sx \ 16 + dx8(n) * 3 / 2 : y = sy \ 16 + dy8(n) * 3 / 2
        If x < 10 Then x = 10
        If x > AW - 11 Then x = AW - 11
        If y < 10 Then y = 10
        If y > AH - 11 Then y = AH - 11
        Queue K_DIAMOND, x, y
      Next
    Case Else       ' a mixed bunch
      For n = 1 To 4
        Spot x, y
        Queue Choose(Rnd(3) + 1, K_WANDER, K_DIAMOND, K_SQUARE), x, y
      Next
  End Select
  Sfx.Play 2, 300, -10, 10, 25, 0
End Sub

' somewhere not too near the ship
Sub Spot(x As Integer, y As Integer)
  Dim t As Integer
  For t = 1 To 10
    x = 12 + Rnd(AW - 24) : y = 12 + Rnd(AH - 24)
    If Abs(x - sx \ 16) + Abs(y - sy \ 16) > 70 Then Exit Sub
  Next
End Sub

Sub Queue(ByVal k As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Dim n As Integer
  For n = 0 To NS - 1
    If st(n) = 0 Then
      sk(n) = k : sxx(n) = x : syy(n) = y : st(n) = 40
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Next
  AddEnemy k, x, y          ' no marker free: straight in
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- particles
Sub Burst(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal c As Integer, ByVal n As Integer)
  Dim k As Integer, a As Integer
  For k = 1 To n
    a = Rnd(16)
    pl(pnext) = 12 + Rnd(14)
    px(pnext) = x * 16 : py(pnext) = y * 16
    pvx(pnext) = Cs(a) * (2 + Rnd(4)) / 4 : pvy(pnext) = sn(a) * (2 + Rnd(4)) / 4
    pc(pnext) = c
    pnext = pnext + 1
    If pnext >= NP Then pnext = 0
  Next
End Sub

Sub Particles()
  Dim k As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer
  For k = 0 To NP - 1
    If pl(k) Then
      pl(k) = pl(k) - 1
      px(k) = px(k) + pvx(k) : py(k) = py(k) + pvy(k)
      x = px(k) \ 16 : y = py(k) \ 16
      L2.Line x, y, x - pvx(k) \ 16, y - pvy(k) \ 16, pc(k)
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the end
Sub GameOver()
  Dim n As Integer
  Tiles.Text 15, 15, "GAME  OVER"
  Hud
  For n = 1 To 150
    L2.Clear
    Particles
    Frame
    L2.Flip
    Sfx.Update
    If n > 50 And FirePressed() Then Exit For
  Next
  Sfx.Quiet
End Sub

files.name: Nx.cls
files.text:
' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Spr.cls
files.text:
' Spr - the Next's 128 hardware sprites, straight on the ports (#303B slot, #57 attributes).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' 4 bit patterns (GfxData.Load puts them in the sprite RAM), 16 x 16 pixels, scaled 1x - 8x.
' Put / Hide write a table in RAM; Show sends the table to the hardware in one go (do it just
' after Frame, so nothing moves half way down the screen).
' Coordinates are the tilemap's: 0, 0 is the top left of the whole 320 x 256 picture (the
' border included); the 256 x 192 paper is 32 - 287 across, 32 - 223 down. A sprite at x -16 .. or
' y -16 .. wraps (512): keep it hidden instead.
Option Explicit

' flags for Put: add them
Public Const MirrorX = 8
Public Const MirrorY = 4
Public Const Rotate = 2
Public Const Scale2X = &H800
Public Const Scale2Y = &H200
Public Const Scale2 = &HA00
Public Const Scale4X = &H1000
Public Const Scale4Y = &H400
Public Const Scale4 = &H1400
' a palette offset: Pal * n (n 0 - 15: spr_pal.png's row n)
Public Const Pal = 16

Private tab(639) As Byte          ' 128 x 5 attribute bytes
Private used As Integer           ' the highest slot Put + 1 (Show sends that many)

' Init: every sprite hidden, sprites on (over the border too), transparent colour 15
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 639
    tab(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 3 To 639 Step 5
    tab(i) = &H40                ' hidden, but still 5 bytes (the upload stays in step)
  Next
  used = 128
  Show
  used = 0
  Nx.Reg &H4B, &HF               ' 4 bit sprites: colour 15 is transparent
  Nx.Reg &H15, (Nx.RegGet(&H15) And &H1C) Or 3   ' sprites on, over the border; the order kept
End Sub

' Put n, x, y, pattern, flags: sprite n (0-127) at x, y showing pattern (0-127), with flags
' (MirrorX + Scale2 + Pal * 2 ...)
Public Sub Put(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal pattern As Integer, ByVal flags As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld c, a
            inc a
            ld hl, {used}
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sp_low
            ld (hl), a
sp_low:
            ld l, c                 ; DE = tab + n * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab}
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl                  ; x
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 0: x bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; x bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; y
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 1: y bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld b, a                 ; y bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; pattern
            ld a, (hl)
            ex af, af'
            pop hl                  ; flags
            ld a, (hl)
            and #FE
            or c
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 2: palette offset, mirrors, rotate, x bit 8
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; scale bits
            ex af, af'
            ld l, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 3: visible, 5 bytes, pattern bits 6-1
            inc de
            ld a, l
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, c
            and #1E
            or b
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, scale, y bit 8
#endasm
End Sub

' Hide n: sprite n not shown
Public Sub Hide(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), #40            ; not visible, 5 bytes kept (else the upload slips a byte)
#endasm
End Sub

' HideRange first, count: those sprites not shown
Public Sub HideRange(ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, hr_done
            ld b, a
            ex de, hl
            ld de, 5
hr_lp:
            ld (hl), #40
            add hl, de
            djnz hr_lp
hr_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to the hardware (the slots up to the highest one Put)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld a, ({used})
            or a
            jr z, sh_done
            ld bc, #303B
            xor a
            out (c), a
            ld a, ({used})
            ld e, a                 ; E sprites, 5 bytes each
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld c, #57
sh_lp:
            ld b, 5
            otir
            dec e
            jr nz, sh_lp
sh_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Visible(n): True when sprite n is shown
Public Function Visible(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld de, 0
            and #80
            jr z, vi_no
            dec de
vi_no:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Tiles.cls
files.text:
' Tiles - the Next's tilemap as a 4 bit picture: 40 x 32 cells of 8 x 8 pixels over the whole
' 320 x 256 display (the border included), 16 colours (tile_pal.png), colour 15 transparent.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' The map stays where the platform put it (bank 5 + #2000, seen at #E000: one byte a cell, the
' tile number), so Print and Locate still work on it: the font is tiles 32-126 (a character's code
' is its tile). The tile definitions go to bank 5 + #0000 (#C000-#DFFF, 32 bytes a tile): the
' ULA screen's place, so the ULA is turned off. Don't use Mode or Cls after Init (Mode puts the
' platform's own text tiles back; Cls is all right but fills with tile 32).
' Print near the right edge or the last row wraps and scrolls: end prints with ; and keep them
' off row 32 and column 40.
Option Explicit

Public Const Cols = 40
Public Const Rows = 32
Private Const MAPA = &HE000

' Init: the tilemap on, 40 x 32, 4 bit tiles from #C000, no attribute bytes, over the ULA;
' the ULA off; no scroll; the whole picture
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H68, Nx.RegGet(&H68) Or &H80     ' the ULA off (its screen's RAM holds the tiles)
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H20                         ' the map: bank 5 + #2000
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &H0                          ' the tile definitions: bank 5 + #0000
  Nx.Reg &H6C, 0                            ' every cell: palette offset 0, no mirror
  Nx.Reg &H4C, &HF                          ' colour 15 transparent
  Nx.Reg &H2F, 0 : Nx.Reg &H30, 0 : Nx.Reg &H31, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 8                            ' the clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 159 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &HA1                         ' on, 40 x 32, no attributes, 4 bit, over the ULA
End Sub

' Put x, y, t: cell x (0-39), y (0-31) shows tile t
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; y
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; y * 40
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Get(x, y): the tile in cell x, y
Public Function Get(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' At(px, py): the tile under pixel px, py (0-319, 0-255), 0 off the map
Public Function At(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; px
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; py
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, at_off
            ld a, d
            cp 2
            jr nc, at_off
            ld hl, -320
            add hl, de
            jr c, at_off
            srl d                   ; px / 8
            rr e
            srl e
            srl e
            ld a, c
            and #F8                 ; (py / 8) * 8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, bc              ; (py / 8) * 40
            ld d, #E0
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            jr at_set
at_off:
            ld e, 0
at_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fill t: every cell tile t
Public Sub Fill(ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 40 * 32 - 1
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t: a block of cells
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Text x, y, s: text from cell x, y (the font tiles), no wrap, no scroll
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
tx_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, tx_done
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            ld a, d
            cp #E5                  ; past the map's end (#E500)
            jr nc, tx_done
            jr tx_lp
tx_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Scroll x, y: the tilemap moved by x (0-319) and y (0-255) pixels
Public Sub Scroll(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H2F, (x \ 256) And 3
  Nx.Reg &H30, x And 255
  Nx.Reg &H31, y And 255
End Sub

files.name: Sfx.cls
files.text:
' Sfx - sound effects on the Next's AY chip (the first of its three), straight on the ports:
' #FFFD picks a register, #BFFD writes it. Three channels, each playing one effect at a time:
' a tone or noise whose pitch slides and whose volume fades to nothing over its length.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Call Update once a frame (50 a second).
'   Sfx.Play 0, 200, 8, 15, 12, 0     ' channel A: tone period 200, rising pitch... 12 frames
Option Explicit

Private per(2) As Integer         ' the tone period now (12 bits; noise: 0-31)
Private slide(2) As Integer       ' added to it each frame
Private vol(2) As Integer         ' the volume it starts at (0-15)
Private total(2) As Integer       ' its length in frames
Private left(2) As Integer        ' frames to go (0 = silent)
Private nse(2) As Integer         ' 1 = noise, 0 = tone
Private mix As Integer

Private Sub W(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #FFFD
            out (c), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, #BF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Init: AY 1 picked (the Next has three: Turbosound), every channel quiet
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  Out &HFFFD, &HFF                 ' AY 1 (Turbosound: #FF, #FE, #FD pick the chips)
  For i = 0 To 13
    W i, 0
  Next
  W 7, &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
  Next
End Sub

' Play ch, period, slidePerFrame, volume, frames, noise: start an effect on channel ch (0-2)
Public Sub Play(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal period As Integer, ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal volume As Integer, ByVal frames As Integer, ByVal noise As Integer)
  If ch < 0 Or ch > 2 Then Exit Sub
  per(ch) = period : slide(ch) = sl : vol(ch) = volume : total(ch) = frames : left(ch) = frames : nse(ch) = noise
End Sub

' Busy(ch): True while channel ch plays
Public Function Busy(ByVal ch As Integer) As Integer
  Busy = (left(ch) > 0)
End Function

' Update: once a frame - the pitches slide, the volumes fade, the AY written
Public Sub Update()
  Dim i As Integer, v As Integer, p As Integer
  mix = &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    If left(i) > 0 Then
      v = (vol(i) * left(i) + total(i) - 1) \ total(i)
      p = per(i)
      If nse(i) Then
        W 6, p And 31
        mix = mix And Not (8 * (2 ^ i))
      Else
        W i * 2, p And 255
        W i * 2 + 1, (p \ 256) And 15
        mix = mix And Not (2 ^ i)
      End If
      W 8 + i, v
      per(i) = per(i) + slide(i)
      If per(i) < 1 Then per(i) = 1
      left(i) = left(i) - 1
    Else
      W 8 + i, 0
    End If
  Next
  W 7, mix
End Sub

' Quiet: every channel stopped
Public Sub Quiet()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
    W 8 + i, 0
  Next
End Sub

files.text:
' L2 - Layer 2 on the ZX Spectrum Next: 256 x 192, 256 colours, two buffers (draw on one while
' the other is shown), clipped lines and points, straight on the hardware.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' The buffers are 16K banks 16-18 and 19-21 (8K pages 32-37, 38-43). Drawing maps the page it
' needs into MMU slot 6 (#C000-#DFFF) and puts bank 5's first half back after (the tilemap's
' tiles live there). Colours are the Layer 2 palette's: as the Next starts, the colour number is
' its colour (RRRGGGBB); #E3 is transparent (what is under Layer 2 shows through).
' Every line drawn is kept in a list for its buffer, so Clear takes them off again by drawing
' them in the background colour - far quicker than wiping 48K when a frame has a few hundred
' lines. A frame:
'     L2.Clear                 ' the lines drawn on this buffer last time, gone
'     L2.Line ...              ' draw (up to 1024 lines and points a frame)
'     Frame : L2.Flip          ' show it at the frame's end, draw on the other next
' Coordinates are signed: a line partly or wholly off the screen is cut to it.
Option Explicit

Private lg(8191) As Byte          ' two lists of up to 1024 lines: x0, y0, x1, y1
Private cnt0 As Integer, cnt1 As Integer
Private cur As Integer            ' the buffer drawn on: 0 = bank 16, 1 = bank 19
Private bankA As Integer, bankB As Integer
Private bg As Integer
Private sps As Integer

' Init backColour: Layer 2 on (256 x 192), both buffers wiped to that colour, the first shown
Public Sub Init(ByVal backColour As Integer)
  bankA = 16 : bankB = 19 : bg = backColour And 255
  cnt0 = 0 : cnt1 = 0
  Nx.Reg &H70, 0                         ' 256 x 192
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 1                         ' its clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 255 : Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 191
  Nx.Reg &H16, 0 : Nx.Reg &H17, 0        ' no scroll
  cur = 1
  Wipe
  cur = 0
  Wipe
  Nx.Reg &H12, bankB                     ' bank 19 shown, 16 drawn on
  Out &H123B, 2                          ' Layer 2 visible
End Sub

' Off: Layer 2 hidden
Public Sub Off()
  Out &H123B, 0
End Sub

' Wipe: the whole buffer drawn on, the background colour (and its list emptied)
Public Sub Wipe()
#asm
            ld ({sps}), sp          ; the real stack (call / ret inside)
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld a, ({cur})
            or a
            ld a, ({bankA})
            jr z, bs_a
            ld a, ({bankB})
bs_a:
            add a, a
            ld (dl_base), a
            ld b, 6
wp_lp:
            push bc
            ld (dl_page), a
            call dl_map
            ld hl, #C000
            ld de, #C001
            ld bc, #1FFF
            ld a, ({bg})
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
            ld a, (dl_page)
            inc a
            pop bc
            djnz wp_lp
            ld hl, 0
            ld a, ({cur})
            or a
            jr nz, wp_b
            ld ({cnt0}), hl
            jr wp_c
wp_b:
            ld ({cnt1}), hl
wp_c:
            ld bc, #243B            ; slot 6 back to bank 5's first half (the tiles)
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
            ld sp, ({sps})
            ret
dl_map:
            push bc
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, (dl_page)
            out (c), a
            pop bc
            ret
dl_page:    db 0
dl_base:    db 0
#endasm
End Sub

' Flip: show the buffer just drawn (call it straight after Frame), draw on the other
Public Sub Flip()
#asm
            ld a, ({cur})
            or a
            ld a, ({bankA})
            jr z, fl_a
            ld a, ({bankB})
fl_a:
            ld bc, #243B
            ld e, a
            ld a, #12
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            ld a, ({cur})
            xor 1
            ld ({cur}), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Clear: the lines drawn on this buffer last time it was drawn on, taken off (drawn again in
' the background colour)
Public Sub Clear()
#asm
            ld ({sps}), sp          ; the real stack (call / ret inside)
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld a, ({cur})
            or a
            ld a, ({bankA})
            jr z, bs_a
            ld a, ({bankB})
bs_a:
            add a, a
            ld (dl_base), a
            ld a, ({bg})
            ld (dl_c), a
            ld a, ({cur})
            or a
            ld hl, ({cnt0})
            ld de, {lg}
            jr z, cr_a
            ld hl, ({cnt1})
            ld de, {lg} + 4096
cr_a:
            ld (cr_n), hl
            ex de, hl
cr_lp:
            ld de, (cr_n)
            ld a, d
            or e
            jr z, cr_done
            dec de
            ld (cr_n), de
            ld de, dl_x0
            ldi
            ldi
            ldi
            ldi
            push hl
            call dl_line
            pop hl
            jr cr_lp
cr_done:
            ld hl, 0
            ld a, ({cur})
            or a
            jr nz, cr_b
            ld ({cnt0}), hl
            jr cr_c
cr_b:
            ld ({cnt1}), hl
cr_c:
            ld bc, #243B            ; slot 6 back to bank 5's first half (the tiles)
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
            ld sp, ({sps})
            ret
cr_n:       dw 0

; ---- draw: dl_x0, dl_y0 -> dl_x1, dl_y1 (on the screen) in colour dl_c, Layer 2 pages from dl_base
dl_line:
            ld a, (dl_x1)
            ld hl, dl_x0
            sub (hl)
            ld c, #2C               ; inc l
            jr nc, dl_px
            neg
            ld c, #2D               ; dec l
dl_px:
            ld (dl_dx), a
            ld a, c
            ld (dl_xm1), a
            ld (dl_xm2), a
            ld a, (dl_y1)
            ld hl, dl_y0
            sub (hl)
            ld c, #24               ; inc h
            jr nc, dl_py
            neg
            ld c, #25               ; dec h
dl_py:
            ld (dl_dy), a
            ld a, c
            ld (dl_ym1), a
            ld (dl_ym2), a
            ld a, (dl_y0)
            ld e, a
            and 31
            or #C0
            ld h, a
            ld a, (dl_x0)
            ld l, a
            ld a, e
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and 7
            ld e, a
            ld a, (dl_base)
            add a, e
            ld (dl_page), a
            call dl_map
            ld a, (dl_c)
            ld c, a
            ld a, (dl_dx)
            ld d, a
            ld a, (dl_dy)
            ld e, a
            cp d
            jr nc, dl_ymaj
            ld b, d                 ; x major: dx + 1 pixels
            inc b
            ld a, d
            srl a
dl_xl:
            ld (hl), c
dl_xm1:
            inc l
            sub e
            jr nc, dl_xn
            add a, d
dl_ym1:
            inc h
            ex af, af'
            ld a, h
            and #E0
            cp #C0
            call nz, dl_wrap
            ex af, af'
dl_xn:
            djnz dl_xl
            ret
dl_ymaj:
            ld b, e                 ; y major: dy + 1 pixels
            inc b
            ld a, e
            srl a
dl_yl:
            ld (hl), c
dl_ym2:
            inc h
            ex af, af'
            ld a, h
            and #E0
            cp #C0
            call nz, dl_wrap
            ex af, af'
            sub d
            jr nc, dl_yn
            add a, e
dl_xm2:
            inc l
dl_yn:
            djnz dl_yl
            ret
; H went off the 8K page: the next one (down) or the one before (up)
dl_wrap:
            ld a, h
            cp #E0
            jr nz, dl_wup
            ld h, #C0
            ld a, (dl_page)
            inc a
            jr dl_wset
dl_wup:
            ld h, #DF
            ld a, (dl_page)
            dec a
dl_wset:
            ld (dl_page), a
dl_map:
            push bc
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56               ; MMU slot 6 (#C000-#DFFF)
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, (dl_page)
            out (c), a
            pop bc
            ret
dl_x0:      db 0
dl_y0:      db 0
dl_x1:      db 0
dl_y1:      db 0
dl_c:       db 0
dl_dx:      db 0
dl_dy:      db 0
dl_page:    db 0
dl_base:    db 0

#endasm
End Sub

' Line x0, y0, x1, y1, colour: a line on the buffer drawn on, cut to the screen
Public Sub Line(ByVal x0 As Integer, ByVal y0 As Integer, ByVal x1 As Integer, ByVal y1 As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (cl_x0), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (cl_y0), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (cl_x1), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (cl_y1), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (dl_c), a
            ld ({sps}), sp          ; the real stack (call / ret inside)
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            call cl_clip
            jr c, ln_none
            ld a, ({cur})
            or a
            ld a, ({bankA})
            jr z, bs_a
            ld a, ({bankB})
bs_a:
            add a, a
            ld (dl_base), a
            call dl_line
            call lg_add
            ld bc, #243B            ; slot 6 back to bank 5's first half (the tiles)
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
ln_none:
            ld sp, ({sps})
            ret

; ---- clip: cl_x0, cl_y0, cl_x1, cl_y1 (signed) to the screen; NC = draw dl_x0 .. dl_y1
cl_clip:
            ld b, 8                 ; at most 8 cuts
cl_again:
            push bc
            ld hl, (cl_x0)
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            call cl_code
            ld (cl_c0), a
            ld hl, (cl_x1)
            ld de, (cl_y1)
            call cl_code
            ld (cl_c1), a
            pop bc
            ld c, a
            ld a, (cl_c0)
            or c
            jr z, cl_in             ; both in
            ld a, (cl_c0)
            and c
            jr nz, cl_out           ; both off the same side
            dec b
            jr z, cl_out
            push bc
            ld a, (cl_c0)
            or a
            jr z, cl_p1
            call cl_cut0            ; point 0 is out: move it
            pop bc
            jr cl_again
cl_p1:
            call cl_swap            ; point 1 is out: swap, move, swap back
            call cl_cut0
            call cl_swap
            pop bc
            jr cl_again
cl_in:
            ld a, (cl_x0)
            ld (dl_x0), a
            ld a, (cl_y0)
            ld (dl_y0), a
            ld a, (cl_x1)
            ld (dl_x1), a
            ld a, (cl_y1)
            ld (dl_y1), a
            or a
            ret
cl_out:
            scf
            ret
; A = the outcode of HL, DE: 1 left, 2 right, 4 above, 8 below
cl_code:
            xor a
            bit 7, h
            jr z, cl_cx1
            or 1
            jr cl_cy
cl_cx1:
            inc h
            dec h
            jr z, cl_cy
            or 2
cl_cy:
            bit 7, d
            jr z, cl_cy1
            or 4
            ret
cl_cy1:
            ld c, a
            ld a, d
            or a
            jr nz, cl_cy2
            ld a, e
            cp 192
            ld a, c
            ret c
            or 8
            ret
cl_cy2:
            ld a, c
            or 8
            ret
cl_swap:
            ld hl, (cl_x0)
            ld de, (cl_x1)
            ld (cl_x0), de
            ld (cl_x1), hl
            ld hl, (cl_y0)
            ld de, (cl_y1)
            ld (cl_y0), de
            ld (cl_y1), hl
            ld a, (cl_c0)
            ld c, a
            ld a, (cl_c1)
            ld (cl_c0), a
            ld a, c
            ld (cl_c1), a
            ret
; point 0 moved onto the edge its code names first (above, below, left, right)
cl_cut0:
            ld a, (cl_c0)
            bit 2, a
            jr z, cl_cb
            ld hl, 0                ; above: y = 0
            jr cl_cuty
cl_cb:
            bit 3, a
            jr z, cl_cl
            ld hl, 191              ; below: y = 191
cl_cuty:
            ; x0 = x0 + (x1 - x0) * (edge - y0) / (y1 - y0) ; y0 = edge
            ld (cl_e), hl
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de              ; edge - y0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld hl, (cl_x1)
            ld de, (cl_x0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de              ; x1 - x0
            ex de, hl
            call cl_muls            ; DEHL = (x1 - x0) * (edge - y0)
            push de
            push hl
            ld hl, (cl_y1)
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l                 ; y1 - y0
            pop hl
            pop de
            call cl_divs            ; HL = DEHL / BC
            ld de, (cl_x0)
            add hl, de
            ld (cl_x0), hl
            ld hl, (cl_e)
            ld (cl_y0), hl
            ret
cl_cl:
            bit 0, a
            jr z, cl_cr
            ld hl, 0                ; left: x = 0
            jr cl_cutx
cl_cr:
            ld hl, 255              ; right: x = 255
cl_cutx:
            ld (cl_e), hl
            ld de, (cl_x0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld hl, (cl_y1)
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ex de, hl
            call cl_muls
            push de
            push hl
            ld hl, (cl_x1)
            ld de, (cl_x0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            pop hl
            pop de
            call cl_divs
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            add hl, de
            ld (cl_y0), hl
            ld hl, (cl_e)
            ld (cl_x0), hl
            ret
; DEHL = DE * BC, signed
cl_muls:
            ld a, d
            xor b
            ld (cl_sg), a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, cl_m1
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a
cl_m1:
            bit 7, b
            jr z, cl_m2
            xor a
            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a
cl_m2:
            ld hl, 0                ; DE x BC unsigned -> HL:IX? (kept: HL high, (cl_lo) low)
            ld a, 16
            ld (cl_n), a
            ld ix, 0
cl_m3:
            add ix, ix
            adc hl, hl
            sla e
            rl d
            jr nc, cl_m4
            add ix, bc
            jr nc, cl_m4
            inc hl
cl_m4:
            ld a, (cl_n)
            dec a
            ld (cl_n), a
            jr nz, cl_m3
            ex de, hl               ; DE high
            push ix
            pop hl                  ; HL low
            ld a, (cl_sg)
            bit 7, a
            ret z
            ; negate DEHL
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d
            ld d, a
            ret
; HL = DEHL / BC, signed (the quotient's low 16 bits; |divisor| > 0)
cl_divs:
            ld a, d
            xor b
            ld (cl_sg), a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, cl_d1
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d
            ld d, a
cl_d1:
            bit 7, b
            jr z, cl_d2
            xor a
            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a
cl_d2:
            ld a, b
            or c
            jr nz, cl_d3
            ld hl, 0
            ret
cl_d3:
            ; DEHL / BC: the remainder in DE as the dividend's bits come in from HL
            ld a, 16
            ld (cl_n), a
            ; first make sure the high word is below the divisor (else the quotient is > 16 bits): clamp
            ex de, hl               ; HL = high, DE = low
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr c, cl_d4
            ld hl, 32767
            jr cl_d7
cl_d4:
            add hl, bc
cl_d5:
            sla e
            rl d
            adc hl, hl
            jr c, cl_d5b
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr nc, cl_d6
            add hl, bc
            jr cl_d6n
cl_d5b:
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
cl_d6:
            inc e
cl_d6n:
            ld a, (cl_n)
            dec a
            ld (cl_n), a
            jr nz, cl_d5
            ex de, hl               ; HL = quotient
cl_d7:
            ld a, (cl_sg)
            bit 7, a
            ret z
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
            ret
cl_x0:      dw 0
cl_y0:      dw 0
cl_x1:      dw 0
cl_y1:      dw 0
cl_c0:      db 0
cl_c1:      db 0
cl_e:       dw 0
cl_sg:      db 0
cl_n:       db 0

; ---- draw: dl_x0, dl_y0 -> dl_x1, dl_y1 (on the screen) in colour dl_c, Layer 2 pages from dl_base
dl_line:
            ld a, (dl_x1)
            ld hl, dl_x0
            sub (hl)
            ld c, #2C               ; inc l
            jr nc, dl_px
            neg
            ld c, #2D               ; dec l
dl_px:
            ld (dl_dx), a
            ld a, c
            ld (dl_xm1), a
            ld (dl_xm2), a
            ld a, (dl_y1)
            ld hl, dl_y0
            sub (hl)
            ld c, #24               ; inc h
            jr nc, dl_py
            neg
            ld c, #25               ; dec h
dl_py:
            ld (dl_dy), a
            ld a, c
            ld (dl_ym1), a
            ld (dl_ym2), a
            ld a, (dl_y0)
            ld e, a
            and 31
            or #C0
            ld h, a
            ld a, (dl_x0)
            ld l, a
            ld a, e
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and 7
            ld e, a
            ld a, (dl_base)
            add a, e
            ld (dl_page), a
            call dl_map
            ld a, (dl_c)
            ld c, a
            ld a, (dl_dx)
            ld d, a
            ld a, (dl_dy)
            ld e, a
            cp d
            jr nc, dl_ymaj
            ld b, d                 ; x major: dx + 1 pixels
            inc b
            ld a, d
            srl a
dl_xl:
            ld (hl), c
dl_xm1:
            inc l
            sub e
            jr nc, dl_xn
            add a, d
dl_ym1:
            inc h
            ex af, af'
            ld a, h
            and #E0
            cp #C0
            call nz, dl_wrap
            ex af, af'
dl_xn:
            djnz dl_xl
            ret
dl_ymaj:
            ld b, e                 ; y major: dy + 1 pixels
            inc b
            ld a, e
            srl a
dl_yl:
            ld (hl), c
dl_ym2:
            inc h
            ex af, af'
            ld a, h
            and #E0
            cp #C0
            call nz, dl_wrap
            ex af, af'
            sub d
            jr nc, dl_yn
            add a, e
dl_xm2:
            inc l
dl_yn:
            djnz dl_yl
            ret
; H went off the 8K page: the next one (down) or the one before (up)
dl_wrap:
            ld a, h
            cp #E0
            jr nz, dl_wup
            ld h, #C0
            ld a, (dl_page)
            inc a
            jr dl_wset
dl_wup:
            ld h, #DF
            ld a, (dl_page)
            dec a
dl_wset:
            ld (dl_page), a
dl_map:
            push bc
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56               ; MMU slot 6 (#C000-#DFFF)
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, (dl_page)
            out (c), a
            pop bc
            ret
dl_x0:      db 0
dl_y0:      db 0
dl_x1:      db 0
dl_y1:      db 0
dl_c:       db 0
dl_dx:      db 0
dl_dy:      db 0
dl_page:    db 0
dl_base:    db 0
; ---- the line just drawn (dl_x0 ..) into the back buffer's list, for Clear
lg_add:
            ld hl, ({cnt0})
            ld a, ({cur})
            or a
            jr z, lg_a
            ld hl, ({cnt1})
lg_a:
            ld de, 1024
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ret nc                  ; the list is full: not logged (it stays on the screen)
            add hl, de
            ld e, l
            ld d, h
            inc hl
            ld a, ({cur})
            or a
            jr nz, lg_b
            ld ({cnt0}), hl
            ld hl, {lg}
            jr lg_c
lg_b:
            ld ({cnt1}), hl
            ld hl, {lg} + 4096
lg_c:
            ex de, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; the entry: base + n * 4
            ld a, (dl_x0)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (dl_y0)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (dl_x1)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (dl_y1)
            ld (hl), a
            ret
#endasm
End Sub

' Plot x, y, colour: a point (off the screen: nothing)
Public Sub Plot(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (dl_c), a
            ld a, d                 ; on the screen?
            or b
            jr nz, pl_none
            ld a, c
            cp 192
            jr nc, pl_none
            ld a, e

' Shape x, y, address, colour: lines from a table, each point relative to x, y: a count of
' points, then each point as two signed bytes (dx, dy); a point dx = -128 lifts the pen (the
' next point starts a new line). Rotated or scaled shapes are made into tables by the program.
Public Sub Shape(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal address As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (sh_x), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (sh_y), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (sh_p), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (dl_c), a
            ld ({sps}), sp          ; the real stack (call / ret inside)
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ; well inside the screen (a shape is +-12 at most): no cutting needed
            xor a
            ld (sh_fast), a
            ld hl, (sh_x)
            ld de, -12
            add hl, de
            ld a, h
            or a
            jr nz, sh_slow
            ld a, l
            cp 256 - 24
            jr nc, sh_slow
            ld hl, (sh_y)
            add hl, de
            ld a, h
            or a
            jr nz, sh_slow
            ld a, l
            cp 192 - 24
            jr nc, sh_slow
            ld a, 1
            ld (sh_fast), a
sh_slow:
            ld hl, (sh_p)
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jp z, sh_done
            ld (sh_n), a
            inc hl
            xor a
            ld (sh_up), a           ; the first point: the pen goes down there
            inc a
            ld (sh_up), a
sh_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            cp #80
            jr nz, sh_pt
            inc hl
            ld a, 1
            ld (sh_up), a
            jp sh_next
sh_pt:
            ld e, a                 ; DE = x + dx
            rla
            sbc a, a
            ld d, a
            push hl
            ld hl, (sh_x)
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            push hl
            ld l, a
            rla
            sbc a, a
            ld h, a
            ld bc, (sh_y)
            add hl, bc              ; HL = y + dy
            ld a, (sh_up)
            or a
            jr nz, sh_move
            ; a line from the last point to this one
            ld (cl_x1), de
            ld (cl_y1), hl
            ld (sh_lx), de
            ld (sh_ly), hl
            ld hl, (sh_px)
            ld (cl_x0), hl
            ld hl, (sh_py)
            ld (cl_y0), hl
            ld a, (sh_fast)
            or a
            jp z, sh_cut
            ld a, (cl_x0)           ; on the screen for sure: straight to the bytes
            ld (dl_x0), a
            ld a, (cl_y0)
            ld (dl_y0), a
            ld a, (cl_x1)
            ld (dl_x1), a
            ld a, (cl_y1)
            ld (dl_y1), a
            jp sh_draw
sh_cut:
            call cl_clip
            jp c, sh_skip
sh_draw:
            ld a, ({cur})
            or a
            ld a, ({bankA})
            jr z, bs_a
            ld a, ({bankB})
bs_a:
            add a, a
            ld (dl_base), a
            call dl_line
            call lg_add
sh_skip:
            ld hl, (sh_lx)
            ld (sh_px), hl
            ld hl, (sh_ly)
            ld (sh_py), hl
            pop hl
            jp sh_next
sh_move:
            ld (sh_px), de
            ld (sh_py), hl
            xor a
            ld (sh_up), a
            pop hl
sh_next:
            ld a, (sh_n)
            dec a
            ld (sh_n), a
            jp nz, sh_lp
            ld bc, #243B            ; slot 6 back to bank 5's first half (the tiles)
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
sh_done:
            ld sp, ({sps})
            ret

sh_y:       dw 0
sh_p:       dw 0
sh_px:      dw 0
sh_py:      dw 0
sh_lx:      dw 0
sh_ly:      dw 0
sh_n:       db 0

; ---- clip: cl_x0, cl_y0, cl_x1, cl_y1 (signed) to the screen; NC = draw dl_x0 .. dl_y1
cl_clip:
            ld b, 8                 ; at most 8 cuts
cl_again:
            push bc
            ld hl, (cl_x0)
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            call cl_code
            ld (cl_c0), a
            ld hl, (cl_x1)
            ld de, (cl_y1)
            call cl_code
            ld (cl_c1), a
            pop bc
            ld c, a
            ld a, (cl_c0)
            or c
            jr z, cl_in             ; both in
            ld a, (cl_c0)
            and c
            jr nz, cl_out           ; both off the same side
            dec b
            jr z, cl_out
            push bc
            ld a, (cl_c0)
            or a
            jr z, cl_p1
            call cl_cut0            ; point 0 is out: move it
            pop bc
            jr cl_again
cl_p1:
            call cl_swap            ; point 1 is out: swap, move, swap back
            call cl_cut0
            call cl_swap
            pop bc
            jr cl_again
cl_in:
            ld a, (cl_x0)
            ld (dl_x0), a
            ld a, (cl_y0)
            ld (dl_y0), a
            ld a, (cl_x1)
            ld (dl_x1), a
            ld a, (cl_y1)
            ld (dl_y1), a
            or a
            ret
cl_out:
            scf
            ret
; A = the outcode of HL, DE: 1 left, 2 right, 4 above, 8 below
cl_code:
            xor a
            bit 7, h
            jr z, cl_cx1
            or 1
            jr cl_cy
cl_cx1:
            inc h
            dec h
            jr z, cl_cy
            or 2
cl_cy:
            bit 7, d
            jr z, cl_cy1
            or 4
            ret
cl_cy1:
            ld c, a
            ld a, d
            or a
            jr nz, cl_cy2
            ld a, e
            cp 192
            ld a, c
            ret c
            or 8
            ret
cl_cy2:
            ld a, c
            or 8
            ret
cl_swap:
            ld hl, (cl_x0)
            ld de, (cl_x1)
            ld (cl_x0), de
            ld (cl_x1), hl
            ld hl, (cl_y0)
            ld de, (cl_y1)
            ld (cl_y0), de
            ld (cl_y1), hl
            ld a, (cl_c0)
            ld c, a
            ld a, (cl_c1)
            ld (cl_c0), a
            ld a, c
            ld (cl_c1), a
            ret
; point 0 moved onto the edge its code names first (above, below, left, right)
cl_cut0:
            ld a, (cl_c0)
            bit 2, a
            jr z, cl_cb
            ld hl, 0                ; above: y = 0
            jr cl_cuty
cl_cb:
            bit 3, a
            jr z, cl_cl
            ld hl, 191              ; below: y = 191
cl_cuty:
            ; x0 = x0 + (x1 - x0) * (edge - y0) / (y1 - y0) ; y0 = edge
            ld (cl_e), hl
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de              ; edge - y0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld hl, (cl_x1)
            ld de, (cl_x0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de              ; x1 - x0
            ex de, hl
            call cl_muls            ; DEHL = (x1 - x0) * (edge - y0)
            push de
            push hl
            ld hl, (cl_y1)
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l                 ; y1 - y0
            pop hl
            pop de
            call cl_divs            ; HL = DEHL / BC
            ld de, (cl_x0)
            add hl, de
            ld (cl_x0), hl
            ld hl, (cl_e)
            ld (cl_y0), hl
            ret
cl_cl:
            bit 0, a
            jr z, cl_cr
            ld hl, 0                ; left: x = 0
            jr cl_cutx
cl_cr:
            ld hl, 255              ; right: x = 255
cl_cutx:
            ld (cl_e), hl
            ld de, (cl_x0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld hl, (cl_y1)
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ex de, hl
            call cl_muls
            push de
            push hl
            ld hl, (cl_x1)
            ld de, (cl_x0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            pop hl
            pop de
            call cl_divs
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            add hl, de
            ld (cl_y0), hl
            ld hl, (cl_e)
            ld (cl_x0), hl
            ret
; DEHL = DE * BC, signed
cl_muls:
            ld a, d
            xor b
            ld (cl_sg), a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, cl_m1
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a
cl_m1:
            bit 7, b
            jr z, cl_m2
            xor a
            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a
cl_m2:
            ld hl, 0                ; DE x BC unsigned -> HL:IX? (kept: HL high, (cl_lo) low)
            ld a, 16
            ld (cl_n), a
            ld ix, 0
cl_m3:
            add ix, ix
            adc hl, hl
            sla e
            rl d
            jr nc, cl_m4
            add ix, bc
            jr nc, cl_m4
            inc hl
cl_m4:
            ld a, (cl_n)
            dec a
            ld (cl_n), a
            jr nz, cl_m3
            ex de, hl               ; DE high
            push ix
            pop hl                  ; HL low
            ld a, (cl_sg)
            bit 7, a
            ret z
            ; negate DEHL
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d
            ld d, a
            ret
; HL = DEHL / BC, signed (the quotient's low 16 bits; |divisor| > 0)
cl_divs:
            ld a, d
            xor b
            ld (cl_sg), a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, cl_d1
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d
            ld d, a
cl_d1:
            bit 7, b
            jr z, cl_d2
            xor a
            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a
cl_d2:
            ld a, b
            or c
            jr nz, cl_d3
            ld hl, 0
            ret
cl_d3:
            ; DEHL / BC: the remainder in DE as the dividend's bits come in from HL
            ld a, 16
            ld (cl_n), a
            ; first make sure the high word is below the divisor (else the quotient is > 16 bits): clamp
            ex de, hl               ; HL = high, DE = low
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr c, cl_d4
            ld hl, 32767
            jr cl_d7
cl_d4:
            add hl, bc
cl_d5:
            sla e
            rl d
            adc hl, hl
            jr c, cl_d5b
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr nc, cl_d6
            add hl, bc
            jr cl_d6n
cl_d5b:
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
cl_d6:
            inc e
cl_d6n:
            ld a, (cl_n)
            dec a
            ld (cl_n), a
            jr nz, cl_d5
            ex de, hl               ; HL = quotient
cl_d7:
            ld a, (cl_sg)
            bit 7, a
            ret z
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
            ret
