            ld bc, #243B            ; slot 6 back to bank 5's first half (the tiles)
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
            ld sp, ({sps})
            ret
ls_n:       dw 0
ls_p:       dw 0

; ---- clip: cl_x0, cl_y0, cl_x1, cl_y1 (signed) to the screen; NC = draw dl_x0 .. dl_y1
cl_clip:
            ld b, 8                 ; at most 8 cuts
cl_again:
            push bc
            ld hl, (cl_x0)
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            call cl_code
            ld (cl_c0), a
            ld hl, (cl_x1)
            ld de, (cl_y1)
            call cl_code
            ld (cl_c1), a
            pop bc
            ld c, a
            ld a, (cl_c0)
            or c
            jr z, cl_in             ; both in
            ld a, (cl_c0)
            and c
            jr nz, cl_out           ; both off the same side
            dec b
            jr z, cl_out
            push bc
            ld a, (cl_c0)
            or a
            jr z, cl_p1
            call cl_cut0            ; point 0 is out: move it
            pop bc
            jr cl_again
cl_p1:
            call cl_swap            ; point 1 is out: swap, move, swap back
            call cl_cut0
            call cl_swap
            pop bc
            jr cl_again
cl_in:
            ld a, (cl_x0)
            ld (dl_x0), a
            ld a, (cl_y0)
            ld (dl_y0), a
            ld a, (cl_x1)
            ld (dl_x1), a
            ld a, (cl_y1)
            ld (dl_y1), a
            or a
            ret
cl_out:
            scf
            ret
; A = the outcode of HL, DE: 1 left, 2 right, 4 above, 8 below
cl_code:
            xor a
            bit 7, h
            jr z, cl_cx1
            or 1
            jr cl_cy
cl_cx1:
            inc h
            dec h
            jr z, cl_cy
            or 2
cl_cy:
            bit 7, d
            jr z, cl_cy1
            or 4
            ret
cl_cy1:
            ld c, a
            ld a, d
            or a
            jr nz, cl_cy2
            ld a, e
            cp 192
            ld a, c
            ret c
            or 8
            ret
cl_cy2:
            ld a, c
            or 8
            ret
cl_swap:
            ld hl, (cl_x0)
            ld de, (cl_x1)
            ld (cl_x0), de
            ld (cl_x1), hl
            ld hl, (cl_y0)
            ld de, (cl_y1)
            ld (cl_y0), de
            ld (cl_y1), hl
            ld a, (cl_c0)
            ld c, a
            ld a, (cl_c1)
            ld (cl_c0), a
            ld a, c
            ld (cl_c1), a
            ret
; point 0 moved onto the edge its code names first (above, below, left, right)
cl_cut0:
            ld a, (cl_c0)
            bit 2, a
            jr z, cl_cb
            ld hl, 0                ; above: y = 0
            jr cl_cuty
cl_cb:
            bit 3, a
            jr z, cl_cl
            ld hl, 191              ; below: y = 191
cl_cuty:
            ; x0 = x0 + (x1 - x0) * (edge - y0) / (y1 - y0) ; y0 = edge
            ld (cl_e), hl
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de              ; edge - y0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld hl, (cl_x1)
            ld de, (cl_x0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de              ; x1 - x0
            ex de, hl
            call cl_muls            ; DEHL = (x1 - x0) * (edge - y0)
            push de
            push hl
            ld hl, (cl_y1)
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l                 ; y1 - y0
            pop hl
            pop de
            call cl_divs            ; HL = DEHL / BC
            ld de, (cl_x0)
            add hl, de
            ld (cl_x0), hl
            ld hl, (cl_e)
            ld (cl_y0), hl
            ret
cl_cl:
            bit 0, a
            jr z, cl_cr
            ld hl, 0                ; left: x = 0
            jr cl_cutx
cl_cr:
            ld hl, 255              ; right: x = 255
cl_cutx:
            ld (cl_e), hl
            ld de, (cl_x0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld hl, (cl_y1)
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ex de, hl
            call cl_muls
            push de
            push hl
            ld hl, (cl_x1)
            ld de, (cl_x0)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            pop hl
            pop de
            call cl_divs
            ld de, (cl_y0)
            add hl, de
            ld (cl_y0), hl
            ld hl, (cl_e)
            ld (cl_x0), hl
            ret
; DEHL = DE * BC, signed
cl_muls:
            ld a, d
            xor b
            ld (cl_sg), a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, cl_m1
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a
cl_m1:
            bit 7, b
            jr z, cl_m2
            xor a
            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a
cl_m2:
            ld hl, 0                ; DE x BC unsigned -> HL:IX? (kept: HL high, (cl_lo) low)
            ld a, 16
            ld (cl_n), a
            ld ix, 0
cl_m3:
            add ix, ix
            adc hl, hl
            sla e
            rl d
            jr nc, cl_m4
            add ix, bc
            jr nc, cl_m4
            inc hl
cl_m4:
            ld a, (cl_n)
            dec a
            ld (cl_n), a
            jr nz, cl_m3
            ex de, hl               ; DE high
            push ix
            pop hl                  ; HL low
            ld a, (cl_sg)
            bit 7, a
            ret z
            ; negate DEHL
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d
            ld d, a
            ret
; HL = DEHL / BC, signed (the quotient's low 16 bits; |divisor| > 0)
cl_divs:
            ld a, d
            xor b
            ld (cl_sg), a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, cl_d1
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d
            ld d, a
cl_d1:
            bit 7, b
            jr z, cl_d2
            xor a
            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a
cl_d2:
            ld a, b
            or c
            jr nz, cl_d3
            ld hl, 0
            ret
cl_d3:
            ; DEHL / BC: the remainder in DE as the dividend's bits come in from HL
            ld a, 16
            ld (cl_n), a
            ; first make sure the high word is below the divisor (else the quotient is > 16 bits): clamp
            ex de, hl               ; HL = high, DE = low
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr c, cl_d4
            ld hl, 32767
            jr cl_d7
cl_d4:
            add hl, bc
cl_d5:
            sla e
            rl d
            adc hl, hl
            jr c, cl_d5b
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr nc, cl_d6
            add hl, bc
            jr cl_d6n
cl_d5b:
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
cl_d6:
            inc e
cl_d6n:
            ld a, (cl_n)
            dec a
            ld (cl_n), a
            jr nz, cl_d5
            ex de, hl               ; HL = quotient
cl_d7:
            ld a, (cl_sg)
            bit 7, a
            ret z
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
            ret
cl_x0:      dw 0
cl_y0:      dw 0
cl_x1:      dw 0
cl_y1:      dw 0
cl_c0:      db 0
cl_c1:      db 0
cl_e:       dw 0
cl_sg:      db 0
cl_n:       db 0

; ---- draw: dl_x0, dl_y0 -> dl_x1, dl_y1 (on the screen) in colour dl_c, Layer 2 pages from dl_base
dl_line:
            ld a, (dl_x1)
            ld hl, dl_x0
            sub (hl)
            ld c, #2C               ; inc l
            jr nc, dl_px
            neg
            ld c, #2D               ; dec l
dl_px:
            ld (dl_dx), a
            ld a, c
            ld (dl_xm1), a
            ld (dl_xm2), a
            ld a, (dl_y1)
            ld hl, dl_y0
            sub (hl)
            ld c, #24               ; inc h
            jr nc, dl_py
            neg
            ld c, #25               ; dec h
dl_py:
            ld (dl_dy), a
            ld a, c
            ld (dl_ym1), a
            ld (dl_ym2), a
            ld a, (dl_y0)
            ld e, a
            and 31
            or #C0
            ld h, a
            ld a, (dl_x0)
            ld l, a
            ld a, e
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and 7
            ld e, a
            ld a, (dl_base)
            add a, e
            ld (dl_page), a
            call dl_map
            ld a, (dl_c)
            ld c, a
            ld a, (dl_dx)
            ld d, a
            ld a, (dl_dy)
            ld e, a
            cp d
            jr nc, dl_ymaj
            ld b, d                 ; x major: dx + 1 pixels
            inc b
            ld a, d
            srl a
dl_xl:
            ld (hl), c
dl_xm1:
            inc l
            sub e
            jr nc, dl_xn
            add a, d
dl_ym1:
            inc h
            ex af, af'
            ld a, h
            and #E0
            cp #C0
            call nz, dl_wrap
            ex af, af'
dl_xn:
            djnz dl_xl
            ret
dl_ymaj:
            ld b, e                 ; y major: dy + 1 pixels
            inc b
            ld a, e
            srl a
dl_yl:
            ld (hl), c
dl_ym2:
            inc h
            ex af, af'
            ld a, h
            and #E0
            cp #C0
            call nz, dl_wrap
            ex af, af'
            sub d
            jr nc, dl_yn
            add a, e
dl_xm2:
            inc l
dl_yn:
            djnz dl_yl
            ret
; H went off the 8K page: the next one (down) or the one before (up)
dl_wrap:
            ld a, h
            cp #E0
            jr nz, dl_wup
            ld h, #C0
            ld a, (dl_page)
            inc a
            jr dl_wset
dl_wup:
            ld h, #DF
            ld a, (dl_page)
            dec a
dl_wset:
            ld (dl_page), a
dl_map:
            push bc
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56               ; MMU slot 6 (#C000-#DFFF)
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, (dl_page)
            out (c), a
            pop bc
            ret
dl_x0:      db 0
dl_y0:      db 0
dl_x1:      db 0
dl_y1:      db 0
dl_c:       db 0
dl_dx:      db 0
dl_dy:      db 0
dl_page:    db 0
dl_base:    db 0
; ---- the line just drawn (dl_x0 ..) into the back buffer's list, for Clear
lg_add:
            ld hl, ({cnt0})
            ld a, ({cur})
            or a
            jr z, lg_a
            ld hl, ({cnt1})
lg_a:
            ld de, 1024
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ret nc                  ; the list is full: not logged (it stays on the screen)
            add hl, de
            ld e, l
            ld d, h
            inc hl
            ld a, ({cur})
            or a
            jr nz, lg_b
            ld ({cnt0}), hl
            ld hl, {lg}
            jr lg_c
lg_b:
            ld ({cnt1}), hl
            ld hl, {lg} + 4096
lg_c:
            ex de, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; the entry: base + n * 4
            ld a, (dl_x0)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (dl_y0)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (dl_x1)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (dl_y1)
            ld (hl), a
            ret
#endasm
End Sub

' Back(): the buffer drawn on (0 / 1)
Public Function Back() As Integer
  Back = cur
End Function

' Used(): lines and points drawn on this buffer since its Clear
Public Function Used() As Integer
  If cur Then Used = cnt1 Else Used = cnt0
End Function
